document.abstract: Hardly a day goes by that we don't see press releases announcing the emergence – for 1971, 1972 or 1973 – of the “X-record” or “Y-vision” with a statement of the price or of the location of program supply, or of news of agreements reached with certain groups on certain processes outlining the rights on certain full-length films.

authors.bio: Claude Soulé is a civil engineer. He is the Technical Director of the Higher Technical Commission and Secretary General of UNIATEC, 92, Champs Elysées, Paris VIII e . He is Professor at the National School of Cinema and Expert at the Trade Court of Paris.
